missing_evidence.what_would_fix_it: rank the universe during holds too and log it WITHOUT acting on it -- a shadow selection row. That is a log-only change: no order path, no cap, no gate, no concurrency change. It makes the c>=2 arms reconstructible from real observed candidates instead of assumed ones. It needs an owner go because it touches the live campaign loop, even though it cannot trade.
missing_evidence.why: run_campaign logs resume_start and calls the session runner directly when a market is held; select_candidate is never reached, so no admitted list, ranking or opportunity score exists for those cycles

opportunity_context.reading: a small rank1-rank2 gap means the second-best market was nearly as good, which is the case where a second concurrent slot would earn its keep; a large gap means the slot is already on the only good opportunity
